findings.summary: The keyboard browser check hard-codes a pre-redesign predecessor for the preparation button and fails before later regression coverage runs.
findings.fix: Calculate or assert the predecessor from the current guardian DOM/tab order for both Shift-alone and Shift+Tab, then retain the editing, capitalization and assignment assertions after that check.
findings.evidence: Lines 28–31 demand the student-create submit button after both backward gestures from #guardian-prepare. T2 moved guardian sections/controls. The parent audit reproduced this assertion failure; the audited current UI completed student creation and assignment with keyboard alone.

passed: Keyboard alone completed first guardian setup, student creation, sample preview and final assignment using Tab/Enter/Space; all required controls were reachable.
Wizard forward/back navigation focuses the current heading; invalid URL and missing-consent errors focus their associated inputs.
Guide native button disclosures support Enter/Space, preserve focus, expose aria-expanded, reopen for same-hash links and operate through expand-all/collapse-all.
Guardian result-page Tab sweeps at 1280×900 and 390×900 found no focused control entirely covered by the fixed assignment bar and no missing focus outline in the inspected tab sequence.
Early analysis cancellation via Escape returned focus to #wizard-submit.
notes: Audit at HEAD 48b3ac1 with Chrome/156.0.8078.80 and Puppeteer against disposable-account server 8892. No production/account database access and no provider calls.

Reproducible baseline defect, not introduced by T0–T6: apps/web/role-portal.js:690 clears state.analysisFocus while #wizard-submit is disabled if cancellation happens during finishAnalysisProgress’s 100%/750ms delay. Materials-only upload → rights check → submit → wait for 100% → Escape resulted in activeElement BODY; next Tab reached footer 실행 정보. Earlier cancellation restored #wizard-submit. Identical focus-restoration logic exists at baseline 36ef70b:527.
Native screen-reader spoken output was not observed; programmatic focus, relationships, state and DOM announcements were inspected. Product files were not edited.
